title: Chain isomorphism for restricted Hom with a fixed projection
statement: For a scheme X and opens V of X and W of V, put F equal to restriction to V followed by the over-site restriction over W [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. Let e(M,N):F(Hom(M,N))≅Hom(F(M),F(N)) be natural in both arguments [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For cochain complexes T,J, P=Hom(T,J), A=F(T), K=F(J), Q=Hom(A,K) [def-pur-hom-complex], and n an integer, there exists a chain isomorphism h:F(P)≅Q whose degree n component satisfies h_n;π_Q=F(π_P);e(T^(-n),J^0), where π_P and π_Q are the fixed product projections in degree n with source index -n and target index 0 [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections].

source.place: Lemma 20.42.3, restriction of internal Hom, expanded via its construction; Section 21.34, Tag 0A8X, product terms and signed differential. Parent plan new-v2-homology-evaluation-restriction-diagrams, steps 1 and 2.

proof.text: Use Scheme.Modules.preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor to preserve products under restriction to V. For the over-site functor over W, compose with the forgetful functor to presheaves of abelian groups: the composite is precomposition by (Over.forget W).op and preserves products. The forgetful functor reflects limits, so over-site restriction preserves products as well. Shrink the restriction limit universe to obtain preservation of Discrete Z limits by the composite F. Use the shared moduleOverFunctor_additive instance for over-site additivity and the source restriction additivity instance for F.

Take the fixed product projections supplied by homComplex_projections_exists for P and Q. Map the limiting fan of P by F. Construct a degreewise isomorphism to the limiting fan of Q by lifting the families F(pi_P);e and pi_Q;e.inv. Product extensionality and the inverse identities of e prove the two composites are identities. The lift equations give the comparison for every degree and every factor.

To prove the chain equation in adjacent degrees, postcompose with all projections of Q in the target degree. Expand both signed differential formulas furnished by homComplex_projections_exists. Use additivity of F, the degreewise projection equations, and he specialized to the identity/source differential and target differential/identity respectively. The two summands agree; product extensionality gives the chain equation. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles the degreewise isomorphisms. The factor equation at source index -n and target index zero is exactly the stated projection identity.

proof_origin.description: Complete product-fan construction and signed differential calculation for the given natural internal-Hom comparison; adapted the proved over-site restriction argument to composite open restriction.

theorem openOver_homComplex_chain_projection_iso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (V : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens)
    (e : ∀ M N : X.Modules,
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) M N) ≅
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).obj M)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).obj N))
    (he : ∀ (M M' N N' : X.Modules) (f : M' ⟶ M) (g : N ⟶ N'),
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).map (SheafOfModules.homObjMap
          (R := X.sheaf) f g) ≫ (e M' N').hom =
        (e M N).hom ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap
          (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
            V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).map f)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor
            V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W).map g))
    (T J : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙
      SheafOfModules.overFunctor V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W
    let P := homComplex (R := X.sheaf) T J
    let A := (moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W).obj T
    let K := (moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W).obj J
    let Q := homComplex (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W) A K
    let π := (Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists
      (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W))) A K n (-n) 0 (by omega)
    ∃ h : (moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor X V W).obj P ≅ Q,
      h.hom.f n ≫ π = F.map (homologyEvaluationProjection X T J n) ≫
        (e (T.X (-n)) (J.X 0)).hom
